date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Public sector bargaining changes (Fair Work referral)
summary: Changes to Victoria's referral of industrial powers to the Commonwealth start, letting certain Victorian public sector employees bargain about staff numbers and appointments, with related changes for police.
who_affected: Victorian public sector employees, including Victoria Police
legal_basis: Act No. 39/2026 s 2: by proclamation, or 1 Nov 2026 at the latest

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Animal abuse material offences, coroners and toll-road fines changes
summary: The rest of the Justice Legislation Further Amendment (Miscellaneous) Act 2026 starts, including new offences about animal abuse material, a wider bestiality offence, a power to re-open finalised coroner investigations and changes to toll-road fine procedures.
who_affected: General public; coroners and courts; toll-road users
legal_basis: Act No. 14/2026 s 2(2)-(3): Parts 3, 6, 8, Pt 4 Divs 5-8, ss 33, 43 start by proclamation or on 1 Nov 2026
notes: No earlier proclamation found in the Government Gazette up to 19 Oct 2026.

date_type: Fixed date
title: TAC benefits for children change
summary: Changes to Transport Accident Act benefits for children start, under the Workplace Legislation Amendment (Accident Compensation and Other Matters) Act 2026.
who_affected: Children injured in transport accidents, and their families
legal_basis: Act No. 45/2026 s 2(1A): Pt 4 Div 2 on 1 Nov 2026

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Family violence intervention order changes
summary: Courts must consider whether someone has been misidentified as the main aggressor, intervention orders can no longer be made against children under 12, and final orders against adults default to 24 months unless the court sets another period.
who_affected: People involved in family violence intervention order cases; courts; police
legal_basis: Act No. 1/2026 s 2(3)-(4): remaining provisions by proclamation or on 10 Nov 2026
notes: Judicial College of Victoria guide gives 10 Nov 2026. Support: 1800RESPECT 1800 737 732; emergencies 000.

date_type: Fixed date
title: Real estate agents' representatives must be registered
summary: Agents' representatives must hold a registration with the Business Licensing Authority (existing ones on the register on 24 November are registered automatically), and new fees apply for estate agents and owners corporation management businesses.
who_affected: Estate agents, agents' representatives, owners corporation managers
legal_basis: Housing Statement Reform Act 2025 (No. 6/2025) s 2(3); Estate Agents (Education) and (Fees) Amendment Regulations 2026 and Owners Corporations Amendment Regulations 2026 commence 25 Nov 2026
notes: OC fee change per CAV OC page: https://www.consumer.vic.gov.au/licensing-and-registration/owners-corporation-managers/new-education-rules-owners-corporation-managers

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Minor domestic building contract changes
summary: General amendments to the Domestic Building Contracts Act 1995 start, including the building work it covers and the warning a contract must contain if the price is likely to vary.
who_affected: Home owners and builders
legal_basis: Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026 (No. 36/2026) s 2(4): Pt 4 Div 1 by proclamation or on 1 Dec 2026
notes: Separate from the main 2025 building contract reforms (see 31 Mar 2027).

date_type: Fixed date
title: 'Permission to teach' becomes 'conditional authority to teach'
summary: The scheme that lets some people teach before full registration is renamed and updated as 'conditional authority to teach' under the Education and Training Reform Act 2006.
who_affected: Teachers and teaching candidates; schools; the Victorian Institute of Teaching
legal_basis: Act No. 38/2026 s 2(2): Parts 3.2 and 3.5 on 1 Dec 2026

date_type: Fixed date
title: Privacy policies must explain automated decisions
summary: Organisations covered by the Privacy Act must say in their privacy policy when computer programs use personal information to make, or substantially help make, decisions that could significantly affect people.
who_affected: Businesses and agencies covered by the Privacy Act; consumers
legal_basis: Privacy and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2024 (Cth) s 2 item 7: Sch 1 Pt 15 on 10 Dec 2026 (new APP 1.7-1.9)

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Production notices to banks for criminal investigations
summary: A new process starts for requiring banks and other financial institutions to produce documents relevant to certain offences, under the Crimes Act 1958.
who_affected: Banks, building societies and credit unions; police
legal_basis: Act No. 32/2026 s 2(2)-(3): s 7A by proclamation or on 21 Dec 2026
notes: The new child-recruitment offence in the same Act is already in force (2 Sep 2026).

date_type: Fixed date
title: Land tax main residence exemption changes
summary: Changes to the land tax principal place of residence exemption, including the Commissioner's power to extend exemption periods, take effect.
who_affected: Home owners and land tax payers

date_type: Fixed date
title: TAFE Funding Guarantee starts
summary: The TAFE Funding Guarantee in the Education and Training Reform Act 2006 starts.
who_affected: TAFE institutes and students
legal_basis: Act No. 12/2026 s 2(2): Pt 4 on 1 Jan 2027

date_type: Fixed date
title: Schools need a student phone and device policy
summary: Having a policy restricting student use of personal electronic devices during school hours becomes a school registration requirement. Schools already registered are treated as complying until 1 July 2027.
who_affected: Schools, students and parents

date_type: Phased start
title: Rental energy efficiency standards: first phase
summary: New minimum energy efficiency standards for rentals start. Broken heaters and hot water systems must be replaced with efficient electric ones; cooling, 4-star showerheads and ceiling insulation apply at a new lease or a switch to month-to-month.
who_affected: Renters and rental providers
legal_basis: Residential Tenancies Amendment (Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards) Regulations 2025
notes: Phased: draughtproofing from 1 Jul 2027; cooling in all rentals from 1 Jul 2030. Exemptions apply.

date_type: Fixed date
title: Supervision agreements for conditional teachers
summary: Conditional authority to teach can only be granted if a supervision and support agreement is in place with the person in charge of the workplace, such as the school principal.
who_affected: Teaching candidates, schools and training providers
legal_basis: Act No. 38/2026 s 2(3): Part 3.3 on 1 Mar 2027

date_type: Compliance deadline
title: AML/CTF independent evaluation deadline (existing businesses)
summary: Businesses already regulated by AUSTRAC that have had an independent review must complete their first independent evaluation under the reformed rules by 31 March 2027, or 4 years after their last review if that is later.
who_affected: Existing AUSTRAC reporting entities (e.g. banks, remitters, gambling businesses)
legal_basis: AML/CTF transitional rules 2026 (AUSTRAC)
notes: A compliance deadline, not a new law starting.

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: New domestic building contract laws
summary: The main Domestic Building Contracts Amendment Act 2025 reforms start, including clearer contract rules, limits on when builders get paid, one process for variations and stronger rights to end major contracts.
who_affected: Home owners, builders and renovators
legal_basis: DBC Amendment Act 2025 s 2(3), as amended by Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026 s 178ZL (1 Dec 2026 replaced by 31 Mar 2027)
notes: The CAV article still says 'by 1 December 2026' (outdated). Could start earlier by proclamation.

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Fishing, Hunting and Outdoor Victoria replaces two authorities
summary: A new body, Fishing, Hunting and Outdoor Victoria, is set up with a Land and Aquatic Access Panel, replacing the Game Management Authority and the Victorian Fisheries Authority.
who_affected: Recreational fishers, hunters and outdoor users; commercial fishing and aquaculture
legal_basis: Fishing, Hunting and Outdoor Victoria Act 2026 (No. 30/2026) s 2: by proclamation, or 1 Apr 2027 at the latest
notes: Bill was introduced as the Outdoor Recreation Victoria Bill 2026.

date_type: Fixed date
title: Annual training (CPD) for agents and conveyancers
summary: Estate agents, agents' representatives and conveyancers must complete at least 5 continuing professional development activities each year (1 April to 31 March).
who_affected: Estate agents, agents' representatives, conveyancers
legal_basis: Housing Statement Reform Act 2025; Conveyancers (Qualifications and Experience) Amendment Regulations 2026 commence 1 Apr 2027
notes: Owners corporation managers start CPD on 1 Apr 2028.

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Voluntary assisted dying law changes
summary: Changes to the Voluntary Assisted Dying Act 2017 start, including letting doctors and nurse practitioners raise it during end-of-life care discussions, a 12-month timeframe in the eligibility criteria and a shorter minimum gap between requests.
who_affected: People with terminal illness, their families, health practitioners
legal_basis: Voluntary Assisted Dying Amendment Act 2025 (No. 50/2025) s 2(2): by proclamation or on 19 Apr 2027

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Renting: lease-break cap, spare keys and more
summary: A cap on what renters can be ordered to pay for ending a fixed-term lease early, rental providers can't unreasonably refuse a request for a spare key or fob, an offence to refuse a renter who pays bond directly to the RTBA, and a ban on refusing to rent to someone because of family or personal violence.
who_affected: Renters, rental providers and agents
legal_basis: Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026 s 2(5): by proclamation, or 1 Jun 2027 at the latest
notes: CAV lists these as 1 June 2027. The cap applies to fixed terms of 5 years or less.

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Changes to section 32 vendor statements
summary: Changes to when section 32 vendor statements must be made available to buyers, and a new requirement for sellers to tell buyers in writing about changes to the statement.
who_affected: Property buyers and sellers; agents and conveyancers
legal_basis: Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026 Pt 9 Div 1 (other than ss 106-108), s 2(5)
notes: Deposit-release changes in the same Division have a later backstop (1 Jul 2027).

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: IVF clinics must meet an accreditation scheme
summary: Registered assisted reproductive treatment providers must comply with an approved accreditation scheme, with changes to registration and inspection powers, among other health regulation changes.
who_affected: IVF and assisted reproductive treatment providers and patients
legal_basis: Health Legislation Amendment (Regulatory Reform) Act 2026 (No. 26/2026) s 2(3): by proclamation or on 2 Jun 2027
notes: Section 9 started 30 Sep 2026 (Gazette S510). Section 5 has a 1 Jan 2029 backstop.

date_type: Compliance deadline
title: Owners corporation managers: training and registration due
summary: Individual owners corporation managers and officers in effective control must complete initial training (5 core units) and register by this date. Already-registered businesses have until 1 August 2027 to register officers.
who_affected: Owners corporation managers; apartment and unit owners
legal_basis: Housing Statement Reform Act 2025 s 2(4): Pt 4 Div 1 by proclamation or on 30 Jun 2027

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Council integrity rules and Fair Jobs Code
summary: The rest of the Local Government Legislation Amendment (Stronger Communities) Act 2026 starts, including council governance and integrity changes, a Fair Jobs Code and regulator, and removing group voting tickets from City of Melbourne elections.
who_affected: Councils, councillors, council suppliers and voters
legal_basis: Act No. 42/2026 s 2(2)-(3): remaining provisions by proclamation or on 1 Jul 2027

date_type: Fixed date
title: Higher nurse and midwife ratios at reclassified hospitals
summary: Reclassified public hospitals with general medical and surgical wards must meet the staffing ratios for their new category. Emergency department changes follow on 1 July 2028.
who_affected: Public hospital patients, nurses and midwives
legal_basis: Safe Patient Care (Ratios) Amendment Act 2026 (No. 34/2026) s 2(2): Pt 2 on 1 Jul 2027
notes: Some obligations are deferred to 1 Jul 2029 for certain hospitals.

date_type: Phased start
title: Rental energy standards: draughtproofing
summary: Rental providers must draughtproof external doors, windows and unsealed wall vents at the start of a new lease or a switch to month-to-month, after a gas safety check where there is gas.
who_affected: Renters and rental providers
legal_basis: Residential Tenancies Amendment (Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards) Regulations 2025

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: New rules on releasing deposits before settlement
summary: Changes to when a deposit paid under a contract for the sale of land can be released before settlement start.
who_affected: Property buyers and sellers; agents and conveyancers
legal_basis: Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026 s 2(5A): ss 106-108

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Training for return-to-work co-ordinators
summary: Employers must meet new obligations to train the people they appoint as return-to-work co-ordinators under the workers' compensation scheme.
who_affected: Employers and injured workers
legal_basis: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Amendment Act 2025 (No. 27/2025) s 2(3): Pt 2 Div 3

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Workplace protection orders
summary: Courts will be able to make orders restricting people who engage in unacceptable conduct connected to certain workplaces, under the Workplace Protection Orders Act 2026.
who_affected: Workers and employers at covered workplaces; the public
legal_basis: Act No. 35/2026 s 2: by proclamation, or 26 Jul 2027 at the latest

date_type: Fixed date
title: Aboriginal cultural understanding training in education
summary: Aboriginal cultural understanding professional development training must be made available to school, early childhood and education department staff.
who_affected: School, early childhood and adult education staff

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: School community safety orders
summary: New school community safety orders under the Education and Training Reform Act 2006 start.
who_affected: Schools, staff, students and parents
legal_basis: Act No. 38/2026 s 2(5): Part 3.4 by proclamation or on 1 Aug 2027

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Good character in sentencing, grooming and intervention orders
summary: Changes to how previous good character and references are used in sentencing, grooming becomes prohibited behaviour for personal safety intervention orders, and changes to extending family violence intervention orders and information sharing.
who_affected: Courts, accused people and victim-survivors; family violence services
legal_basis: Act No. 41/2026 s 2(3): Parts 3, 4, 7, 8, 11 and Pt 9 Div 2 by proclamation or on 9 Aug 2027
notes: The new coercive control offence in the same Act starts by 1 Mar 2028 at the latest (outside this calendar). Support: 1800RESPECT 1800 737 732.

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Workplace safety: reckless endangerment and coercive conduct
summary: The rest of the Workplace Legislation Amendment (Accident Compensation and Other Matters) Act 2026 starts, including changes to reckless endangerment offences, a ban on coercive conduct and new health and safety orders under workplace safety law.
who_affected: Employers, workers, health and safety representatives
legal_basis: Act No. 45/2026 s 2(2)-(3): Pt 1A, Pt 2 Div 1, Pts 5, 5A, 5B by proclamation or on 10 Sep 2027

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Planning system changes (Better Decisions Made Faster)
summary: The remaining changes to the Planning and Environment Act 1987 under the Planning Amendment (Better Decisions Made Faster) Act 2026 start, covering planning schemes, permits, compliance and infrastructure contributions.
who_affected: Home owners, developers, councils, objectors
legal_basis: Act No. 3/2026 s 2(1A)-(2): remaining provisions by proclamation or on 29 Oct 2027

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Building and Plumbing Commission and Building Appeals Tribunal
summary: The Building and Plumbing Administration and Enforcement Act 2026 starts, restating building and plumbing regulation and setting up the Building and Plumbing Commission and the Building Appeals Tribunal.
who_affected: Builders, plumbers, building surveyors, home owners
legal_basis: Act No. 17/2026 s 2(2): by proclamation, or 1 Dec 2027 at the latest

date_type: No later than (could start earlier by proclamation)
title: Car traders, apartments, prefab building and land lease changes
summary: Remaining Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026 changes start, including motor car trader reforms, owners corporation payment plans and proxy voting, prefabrication and complex plumbing rules, property sale data and Part 4A park rules.
who_affected: Car buyers and traders; apartment owners; builders; residents of land lease parks
legal_basis: Consumer Legislation Amendment Act 2026 s 2(6): Pt 5 Div 1, Pt 6 Div 2, Pt 7 Div 4, Pt 12, Pt 12A Divs 1-2 by 1 Dec 2027
notes: ss 178ZF and 178ZJ already started on 16 Sep 2026 (Gazette S510).
